headline: Nigerian Food Price Index Declines 0.75% Month-on-Month in October
summary: Nigeria's Food Price Index recorded a 0.75% drop in October compared to the prior month, providing modest sequential relief, although food prices remain 19% higher on an annual basis.
why: Food inflation accounts for the largest weighting in Nigeria's consumer basket, directly influencing central bank interest rate decisions and consumer spending power.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: A slight monthly easing helps ease headline pressure, though high year-on-year costs continue to squeeze household budgets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
